title: BPO Service Delivery — Command Center
tagline: From inbound ticket to executive brief, with zero manual re-entry.
painPoint: Supervisors triage cases by hand, and nothing rolls up to leadership until someone writes a status report.

steps.caption: The BPO War Room
steps.talk: This is the War Room — every inbound case lands here the instant it's created. No queue, no waiting for a human to open the ticket.

steps.caption: Engines auto-fire on intake
steps.talk: Watch the engine count. The moment this case hit the queue, multiple specialist engines fired automatically, in parallel. Nobody clicked ‘analyze.’ This already happened before your operator even looked at it.

steps.caption: One-click routing
steps.talk: One click routes the case to the strategist layer. The system already knows this needs escalation — it isn't guessing, it's reasoning from what the engines found.

steps.caption: Strategist workspace
steps.talk: This is where case complexity gets synthesized into something a decision-maker can actually act on.

steps.caption: Auto-generated strategy brief
steps.talk: This used to take a senior analyst twenty to thirty minutes of digging through history. Watch the reasoning box build a full strategy brief in seconds — and it shows the *why*, not just the *what*.

steps.caption: Escalate to executive
steps.talk: One click escalates straight to the executive portal. Same case, same context, zero re-entry, zero copy-paste.

steps.caption: Live executive KPIs
steps.talk: Leadership sees exposure and throughput live — nobody has to ask a supervisor for a status update.

steps.caption: Full explainability
steps.talk: And this is what actually closes deals with skeptical buyers: every number on this dashboard traces back to the reasoning that produced it. Nothing here is a black box.

cta: TSM turns a BPO's triage backlog into a same-second decision chain — with an audit trail leadership can defend.
